messages:
maya: Heads-up — canary perf alert for int8 packer (model=int8-v2). After merge 0f9a3d we see ~25% p50 token latency increase and a throughput cliff at batch=8 in perf/e2e-gpu. CI job 127 failed its perf guard. Logs attached.

sam: link to flamegraph? :eyes: can you paste the exact perf command you ran?

maya: flamegraph uploaded https://internal.corp/redwood/flame/2444012345 — repro command:
```
./run_perf --model=int8-v2 --seq_len=1024 --batch=8 --runtime=canary --iters=200
```

sam: quick glance at the flame looks like dequant hotpath + KV churn. can you paste sampled stacks?

maya: top of sampled stacks:
```
45.1% dequant::slow_path
18.3% kv_cache::lookup
12.2% kernel_selector::score_and_bind
```

ryan: FYI I suspect the kernel-selection heuristic we merged biased selection toward a new int8->fp32 vectorized path for short sequences. That could increase on-demand dequant/copy work and interact badly with kv-prefetch. Candidate range for bisect: 0f9a3d..1b7c22. starting git bisect now.

tess: pinging infra/ops — if bisect reproduces we should hold canary and be ready to rollback. @tess: can you grant temporary rollback?

infra-bot: alert: canary cluster c-17 node-gpu-8 reporting memcpy rate doubled since 0f9a3d; IO spikes correlate with perf job windows.

sam: can you try toggling KV prefetch? quick experiment: run with `--kv-prefetch=off` and see effect.

maya: ran with kv_prefetch=off — p50 back to baseline (~baseline -2%). So KV prefetch interaction looks like the amplifier, not the root but necessary to trigger.

eli: hypothesis: kernel_selector change prefers a packed int8 kernel that emits a dequant + memcpy fastpath; when kv-prefetch overlaps it causes thrash (blocking copies). Try setting runtime override: `KERNEL_PREFERENCE=legacy_int8` and repro.

maya: setting `KERNEL_PREFERENCE=legacy_int8` — p50 restores baseline. running git bisect now to isolate which commit toggled the preference.

ci-bot: CI alert summary: perf/e2e-gpu/127 p50 +24%, p99 +12% after merge 0f9a3d. Tags: int8, kernel-selector, kv-prefetch.

ryan: plan: 1) bisect to a single commit; 2) open an emergency revert PR for the kernel-selector heuristic; 3) add a perf CI guard with kv_prefetch=on + int8 workloads so this doesn't slip. Assigning: @sam for perf verification, @eli for kernel fix.

tess: temporary rollback approved for canary once revert PR is up. also can we add a telemetry flag to log kernel selection decisions per request? would help root cause.

maya: added trace id trace/2444012345-az1 to the bisect PR with attached perf profiles and command lines. I'll keep running targeted reproductions with kv prefetch toggles and KERNEL_PREFERENCE overrides.

sam: thanks — I'll repro locally and try smaller batch sweep to see threshold points. posting results in the bisect PR. :thumbsup:

ryan: starting bisect run now, will update with first bad commit.

infra-bot: note: please coordinate rollback during low-traffic window; canary autoscaler may move pods.

maya: copy. will coordinate with infra on rollback window if bisect pins it down.

(ended: planning bisect + revert; short-term mitigation: KERNEL_PREFERENCE=legacy_int8 or kv_prefetch=off until revert lands)
